validation.browserSmoke: Passed full gameplay browser smoke and effects suite. Seven selectable worlds, remembered Space/neon preferences, desktop/mobile layouts, distinct scenery, custom crash/trail effects, shader output with correct alpha blending and no GL errors, rewind/replay-only paths, reduced motion, Canvas fallback and context restoration checked.

replayFrameCadence.environment: Headless Edge, 90 requestAnimationFrame callbacks during active replay
replayFrameCadence.limitation: Observed average display cadence, not a minimum guarantee or GPU benchmark.

validation.performance: See audit/performance.json: unchanged large-track benchmark plus separate active effects fixture.

limits: Source references prove local traceability, not exhaustive test coverage or current agreement with a remote specification.
Studio authentication expired. Replay entries are pending_spec, and latest momentum/view/wildlife corrections require remote synchronization.
The original parameterized momentum model used bounded exploration; current model scenarios have not been reassessed after the final corrections.
Scenery in replay interpolates recorded round snapshots; drivers move simultaneously by round rather than reproducing real-world pauses between individual clicks.
Display cadence targets the screen refresh rate; actual frame rate depends on hardware, browser load and display settings.
Recordings are local to the current race and reset on new race or reload.
Source remains local; only hashes and references may be synced after Studio reconnects.
changeReview: Added Jungle, Sky, Sea and Space with pixel props, wildlife and data-driven per-world crash/hidden-path effects. Existing themes also share the effect registry. Particle seeds now derive from action state instead of wall-clock start time. Hidden-path-only marks, replay-only route overlay, acceleration/friction-only road smoke, physics and bounded effect budgets are preserved. 36 tests and both browser suites pass. Studio synchronization remains pending authentication.
